headline: Ahluwalia Contracts shares extend gains after securing a Rs 310 crore order from Bennett University
hook: Four-day rally driven by fresh order
summary: Ahluwalia Contracts shares extended their winning streak to four days following a Rs 310 crore order win from Bennett University. The contract involves building university blocks and is slated for completion within 22 months. The company confirmed that the transaction is not a related-party deal. For Indian retail investors, large construction and infrastructure order wins signal potential revenue visibility and project execution capacity.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results reflecting order book execution
why_it_matters: Order inflows boost revenue visibility for construction holdings.
